ownerStatement: Approved by repeat98 in chat 14 Oct 2026: release Mute Modes 0.2.0.
reason: The owner approved this exact native source: Zac-Kyoti's 0.1.0 with its runtime package's fresh_bind detour replaced by an ev_voice_bind subscriber (order 50) that runs the same fresh_bind code; native builds, plain and SC_KEY, assemble byte-identical to the author's references. The OT pages and controls are unchanged, so the 0.1.0 captures are retained. Evidence is emulator-only (synthetic mute/mode words); current-build hardware, chip worst-case timing and complete memory bounds stay waived for this exact version only, and the author's historical hardware evidence stays historical. Native/browser parity, source-only reproduction and repository checks remain required; the release can only publish once a base built with site events ships.
